title: Riddle Grid
summary: Solve one short daily deduction grid with four illustrated clues.
user: Coffee-break puzzle players fatigued by spelling games who want one short daily deduction puzzle with a satisfying reveal.
smallest_useful_product: Daily 4x4 grid: arrange four illustrated clues under two rules, with exactly one final layout. Each attempt can request one visible constraint at a score cost; reveal gives a compact explanation.
constraints: Hand-author and validate all v1 puzzles for a unique solution; avoid cultural-knowledge assumptions and tracking scripts.
